_about: Synthetic test leads for a Bangalore real-estate lead-scoring tool. Names/phones are fictional. Message styles are modelled on public inquiry datasets (Manu-SMR/real-estate-agent) and typical portal/WhatsApp inquiries. Price ranges are approximate 2025-26 Bangalore market levels - verify on 99acres/MagicBricks before relying on them.
_assumed_company: Developer/broker with projects ONLY in Bangalore (Whitefield, Sarjapur Road, Electronic City, Hebbal, Bannerghatta Road, Devanahalli).
_scoring_rubric: Budget fit 0-25 | Timeline urgency 0-25 | Intent clarity 0-20 | Readiness (loan/visit/call) 0-20 | Engagement 0-10. 70+ Hot, 40-69 Warm, <40 Cold. Spam/out-of-area = Disqualified.

leads.name: Rohit Kulkarni
leads.message: Hi, I'm relocating from Pune for my new job at ITPL, joining on 15th. Looking for a ready-to-move 3BHK near ITPL, budget around 1.6Cr. Home loan already sanctioned from HDFC for 1.2Cr. Can I visit this Saturday? Also please share the maintenance charges and whether OC is received.

key_signals: asked for site visit with a date
expected.next_action: Call within 15 minutes, confirm Saturday site visit, shortlist ready-to-move 3BHKs with OC.

leads.name: Sneha Reddy
leads.message: Our rental lease ends in March so we want to buy a 2BHK on Sarjapur Road, preferably near Wipro campus. Budget max 95L incl. registration. Is there any project with possession before April? We have 20L down payment ready.

expected.next_action: Call today, share 2-3 ready/near-ready 2BHK options under 95L all-inclusive, propose site visit.

leads.name: Arjun Mehta
leads.message: Interested in 2BHK in Electronic City Phase 1. Budget ~70L. Will need a home loan, haven't applied yet. Please share brochure and price list.

expected.next_action: Send brochure + price list on WhatsApp, offer free loan-eligibility check, follow up in 2 days.

leads.name: Priya Nair
leads.message: Looking at 3BHK options near Hebbal flyover for my parents. Will decide after discussing with my brother who is in the US, he will co-fund. Need good ventilation, lift with power backup, close to a hospital.

key_signals: decision depends on another person (authority split)
expected.next_action: Offer a video walkthrough both siblings can join; highlight hospital proximity, lift backup.
Send automated price-range message with 2 qualifying questions (budget, BHK); no call yet.

leads.name: Vikram Joshi
leads.location: Whitefield, Sarjapur, Hebbal, Yelahanka, JP Nagar
leads.message: Just exploring options in Bangalore. Not in a hurry. Send whatever you have.

expected.next_action: Add to monthly newsletter/nurture list; re-check in 60 days.

leads.name: Ananya Iyer
leads.message: Need a 3BHK independent villa in Whitefield urgently, max 60 lakhs. Can pay full amount in cash, want to register this month.

key_signals: BUT budget far below market (villa in Whitefield is 2Cr+)
expected.next_action: Call to reset expectations: suggest 2BHK apartment in Whitefield or villa plots in Devanahalli/Hoskote within budget.
expected.why_tricky: Urgency is high but budget-fit is near zero. Tool should NOT mark Hot just because of 'urgently'.

expected.next_action: Senior agent personal call - high ticket size justifies effort despite low intent signal.
expected.why_tricky: Big budget but low intent. Tests whether tool balances deal value vs. intent; should flag 'high value' even if score is mid.

leads.name: Mohammed Faizal
leads.message: Bhai mujhe Bannerghatta Road pe 2BHK chahiye, budget 85L tak. Bachho ka school wahi pe hai to next academic year se pehle shift hona hai. Loan ka process chalu hai SBI se. Weekend pe site dikha sakte ho?

expected.next_action: Reply in Hinglish, book weekend site visit, ask loan sanction amount.
expected.why_tricky: Tests Hinglish understanding; tool must extract same signals as an English message.

leads.name: Deepa Krishnan
leads.message:
[10:02] Deepa: Hi saw your ad on FB for Green Meadows E-City
[10:03] Agent: Hello ma'am, yes 2BHK starting 62L
[10:05] Deepa: Is it RERA approved? Last builder I booked with delayed possession by 2 years, lost a lot
[10:06] Agent: Yes RERA registered
[10:08] Deepa: ok what is the possession date and can I see the RERA number. Also is there a 9:1 payment plan?
[10:15] Deepa: ??

expected.next_action: Immediately share RERA number + possession date + payment plan; address delay fear with builder track record.
expected.why_tricky: Pasted chat transcript; strong objection that is actually a buying signal. Agent left her waiting - urgency to respond.

leads.name: Sanjay Patil
leads.message: Do you have any 2BHK projects in Andheri West? Need it in 2 months.

expected.next_action: Politely decline / refer to partner; do not spend call time.
expected.why_tricky: Good budget and timeline but wrong city. Tests business-rule awareness.

leads.name: TechGrow Solutions
leads.message: Hello sir, we provide digital marketing and lead generation services for real estate builders. Get 500 leads/month guaranteed. Call 98XXXXXX10.

leads.name: Neha Gupta
leads.message: I'm an NRI based in Dubai, looking to invest in a 2BHK near Sarjapur tech parks for rental income. What rental yield can I expect? Need someone to handle paperwork since I can't travel often. Can do video call.

objections: needs NRI paperwork help (POA, NRE account)
expected.next_action: Schedule video walkthrough, share rental yield data and NRI purchase process (POA).
expected.why_tricky: Can't do site visit - tool should not penalise lack of visit when video call is offered.

leads.name: Amit Shah
leads.message: Visited your Whitefield project last week with Ramesh. Liked the 3BHK east facing on 12th floor. But Prestige next door is offering 5% lower and free car parking. If you can match I'm ready to book.

expected.next_action: Escalate to sales manager today for negotiation approval; risk of losing to competitor.
expected.why_tricky: Price objection + competitor mention looks negative, but this is the closest-to-booking lead in the set.

leads.name: Lakshmi Rao
leads.message: Interested in BMRDA approved plots near Devanahalli airport. Want to build a house after retirement in 2 years. Is the layout A-Khata? Clear title?

expected.next_action: Share approval docs + khata details, invite to weekend plot visit; nurture monthly.
expected.why_tricky: Long horizon but very informed buyer; tool should value document questions as intent.

expected.next_action: Quick qualifying call to confirm urgency.
expected.why_tricky: Form fields and message disagree in strength - tool must weigh both, not just one.

leads.name: Pooja & Nikhil Sharma
leads.message: We're a working couple with a 4-year-old. Want a gated society with a clubhouse and an international school within 3 km. We've shortlisted 2 other projects but yours looked good. Possession should be by June. Both of us have loan pre-approval. Can we get a callback after 7 PM on weekdays?

expected.next_action: Call after 7 PM today; lead with school distance + clubhouse; send comparison vs competitors.
expected.why_tricky: Gave a preferred call time - next action must respect it (good test for the 'next action' quality).

leads.name: Suresh Babu
leads.message: Anything 1BHK under 35L in E City? Ready to move only. Bank approved for 30L.

key_signals: budget slightly tight but possible for resale 1BHK
expected.next_action: Check resale/1BHK inventory; if none, say so honestly and suggest nearby Chandapura.
expected.why_tricky: Strong readiness, borderline budget fit - should land upper Warm, not Hot or Cold.
